# FG-DOC-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_bounded_doc_index_is_never_a_silent_pass` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 文書が多すぎるか大きすぎるため、一部しか検査できていません。結果は読めた範囲のものです。
- en: Only part of the documents could be checked: there are too many, or they are too large. The results are about what was read.
- id: Hanya sebagian dokumen yang dapat diperiksa: terlalu banyak atau terlalu besar. Hasilnya hanya untuk bagian yang terbaca.

## 原因 (cause)

Reading a revision's documents for the document lint stops at its bounds rather than run unbounded, and says so instead of passing. Server (`forge/doc-lint`, forge-checks doc_lint DocLimits): the head's tree listing over 50000 entries or 8 MiB (`doc_tree`), more than 2000 `.md` files (`doc_files`), more than 100 files over the parser's limit (`doc_large_files`; each is read only up to the limit + 1 byte — 1 MiB for a document, 64 KiB for a type definition — as gstn reads it, so a large Markdown file without a `doctype` is no bound), more than 32 MiB read in all (`doc_bytes`), more than 64 type definitions (`doctype_files`); the run concludes `neutral` when it found no problem (a broken reference alone is no failure then: the target may be in what was not read). The document API (`GET …/documents[/{doc_id}]`, plan 13 stage 3) reads with the same server bounds and answers `incomplete {error_code: FG-DOC-0002, reason}` beside what it read (a reference may then read `broken` although its target exists); its referrers route (`…/documents/{doc_id}/referenced-by`) also answers `reason: doc_refs` when a document it may show hit the parser's 5000 references per document (`MAX_REFS_PER_DOCUMENT`, lint rule `too_many_references`), so a referrer may be missing — split that document; and its versions route (`…/documents/{doc_id}/versions`, plan 13 stage 4) answers `reason: doc_versions` when more than 5000 merges were applied to the default branch (the version numbers then count the merges read). Client (`gstn doc lint` / `gstn doc fmt`, forge-client doc): more than 5000 `.md` files (`doc_files`), more than 64 MiB of `.md` (`doc_bytes`), a `git ls-files` listing over 16 MiB (`doc_tree`), more than 64 type definitions (`doctype_files`), or a file name that is not UTF-8 (`path_not_utf8`); gstn exits 1 with this code when it found no other problem. Not a server fault. Merge queue (plan 18 S1, ADR-0037 (b)), context `scope=train`: the document lint of a merge-queue train (the tree of its last step, forge-checks train_lint) could not be completed, so the train does not land — never a pass. `reason=train_budget`: not finished within `merge_queue.train_lint_budget_ms` (default 10000). `reason=read_failed`: a tree, `.forge/repo.yml` (the base's, or the last step's when the base's is invalid), the migration setting or the `forge/doc-lint` check run could not be read or written (`cause` is the underlying code), or a bound of the train's reading was hit (`bound`: `doc_tree`, `doc_files` over 20000 `.md` files, `doc_large_files`, `doc_bytes` over 64 MiB, `doctype_files`). The batch is `abandoned` with `reason=doc_lint_unavailable`, its entries go back to the queue with one more attempt, and an entry abandoned for the third time is removed with FG-CI-0024 and `reason=doc_lint_unavailable` (not `stalled`). The budget ends the wait, not the work: a tree's lint is one call on a blocking thread and runs to its end after the budget fired (its result is dropped), so repeated timeouts can leave a few CPU-bound lints behind, each capped by the bounds above.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The run's summary (server) or the warning line on stderr / `incomplete.reason` in --json (gstn) names the bound. Count the Markdown files: git ls-files '*.md' | wc -l. The job's log event `forge.spec_index.recorded` carries `doc_incomplete` with `request_id`. `scope=train`: `forge serve` logs `forge.merge_queue.train_lint_unavailable` (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id` (the batch's), `queue_id`, `batch_id`, `base_sha`, `train_sha`, `scope`, `reason`, `elapsed_ms`, and `cause` / `bound` / `budget_ms` / `source` only when known (an absent field has nothing to say); the third-time removal is `forge.merge_queue.entry_removed` (warn, FG-CI-0024, `reason=doc_lint_unavailable`) with the same `lint_reason` / `cause` / `bound` / `budget_ms`; the batch row reads `state=abandoned, reason=doc_lint_unavailable` (read-only: SELECT id, state, reason, error_code FROM forge.merge_queue_batches WHERE queue_id = <queue_id> ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10).

## 対処 (fix)

Keep the repository within the bounds: fewer or smaller Markdown files (split a large document; plan 13 §8.2 suggests at most 1500 lines), or move generated Markdown out of the repository. Nothing to change on the server. `scope=train`: follow runbook merge-queue — `reason=train_budget`: raise `merge_queue.train_lint_budget_ms` (at most 60000) or shrink the repository's documents; `reason=read_failed`: follow the code in `cause` (the repository's storage, the database), or keep the repository within the `bound`. The entries are retried by themselves; those removed with FG-CI-0024 (`reason=doc_lint_unavailable`) are added to the queue again once the cause is gone (an auto-merge merge request stays stopped, `merge_queue_doc_lint_unavailable`, until its head changes or merge-when-ready is pressed again).
